entries.en: You try again, you hear me?!
entries.ro: Mai încearcă o dată, ai auzit?!

entries.en: Corpos ain't lettin' anyone through! How many times I gotta fuckin' repeat myself?

entries.en: Oh, so you're just gonna leave the kids in there?!
entries.ro: A, deci îi lași pe copii acolo?!

entries.en: It's my life! I got a right to do whatever I wanna do with it!
entries.ro: E viața mea! Am dreptul să fac ce vreau cu ea!

entries.en: What life?! Gettin' your daily dick-fix while I work my ass off?

entries.en: Kids wouldn't be alone if their mom wasn't trampin' 'round the entire city.
entries.ro: Copiii n-ar fi singuri dacă mă-sa n-ar umbla toată ziua prin oraș.

entries.en: That's rich, comin' from a drunk!
entries.ro: Asta-i bună, de la un bețiv!
